coaching.headline: We won the first three fights (2.4, 3.3, 9.9) and cashed one — then their 12 won fights cashed 9 times and Drongo finished 24/6.
coaching.team: The first ten minutes were ours: 2-0 at 2.4, 3-1 at 3.3, 4-1 at 9.9 — and we converted one of them. The 12.3 bad trade (2-5 in their half, all five of us across the map with no objective up) handed the tempo back, and from 14 to 25 minutes their fight wins cashed into Fangtooth at 16.4 and a tower row from 14.6 to 25.2. The rule this game teaches: an early fight lead is only real if it becomes towers and Fangtooth inside 90 seconds.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 12.3-minute 2-5 bad trade in their half flipped a won early game, and the 15.5 fight (0-4 at their Fangtooth, taken while our jungler was ahead elsewhere and never called over) started the tower cascade.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock's 11 deaths were the game's biggest single leak, and the film shows what each bought: the 14-minute death cost the tower at 14.6, the 15.5 death cost Fangtooth plus a tower, 19.6 cost another tower, 23.8 fed the inner-tower row. The lane itself read even; the deaths came from taking flat fights against a Drongo who out-scaled everyone. Picking fights only off a numbers edge was the answer.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Adele placed 28 wards — the support workload was carried. The 10 deaths were mostly team-wide wipes, and the macro repeatedly shows fights being started while Adele was pinned in a losing lane (14, 22.1, 26.8) — those were the wrong fights for the team to take, not Adele's failures to attend.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Countess won the jungle read all game but finished 1/9/5 with no armor against a 3-physical comp — the flagged build gap. The sharpest moment: at 15.5 the macro shows the jungle alive and ahead while the team went 0-4 at their Fangtooth; shoving and rotating there flips the fight. Caught twice by Drongo (16.3, 37.5) — on Countess, the flank entrance needs the team already committed.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,500 hero damage a minute, more than 92% of Drongo carry players this patch (34% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Rounds, Sky Splitter, Scattershot.
Drongo dealt 56,987 hero damage, 34% of their team's, with +302 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Adele (level 16: about 206 physical armor, 194 after penetration; took 32,680 physical damage from heroes, 59% of all hero damage they took) and Countess (level 17: about 102 physical armor, 90 after penetration; took 12,857 physical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) that is about 4% and 6% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
Bring The Boom (augment): Rad Rounds deals 60% of its damage to nearby Enemies upon exploding.

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 4,108 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Sky Splitter, Scattershot, Lightning Hawk, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Sky Splitter, Pacifier, Savage Strikes.

Countered? 1 of the 4 players Drongo killed built physical armor (Adele). Anti-heal on Murdock, Gadget, Adele. We killed Drongo 6 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 54.4% in 349 Drongo carry games, above the hero's 50.1%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

wraith.loadout: Demiurge (Construct + Bloatware), augment Mystic Marksman, crest Ortus
fedBy: Malady (Demise): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage.• Gain a stack of Demise.• Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise.• Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Ortus (Limit Breaker): Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s.• Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,446 hero damage a minute, more than 88% of Wraith mid players this patch (36% of the team's). The damage came from Malady, Noxia, Alternata.
Back It Up! at rank 3: 95s base, about 59s by the end (38% shorter) from 61 ability haste: Malady 8, Noxia 20, Alternata 10, Mutilator 15, Ortus 8.
20 takedowns (15 kills, 5 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Ortus (Limit Breaker).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Wraith dealt 54,956 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +207 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Alternata 12, Vanquisher 12, Ortus 5; against Gideon (level 18: about 109 physical armor, 69 after penetration; took 20,275 physical damage from heroes, 42% of all hero damage they took) and Kallari (level 18: about 109 physical armor, 69 after penetration; took 8,480 physical damage from heroes, 40% of all hero damage they took) that is about 24% and 24% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Malady (item): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Alternata (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
Demiurge (Eternal): Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.
Bloatware (Eternal minor): Gain 0.5% increased Damage and 0.75% Damage Reduction per Item.
Sustain: 12% omnivamp; 4,144 healing recorded.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: Gideon took about 24% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 18 their armor was about 109, about 69 after 40 flat penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Noxia, Wraith Leggings, Mutilator. Wraith has 2 damaging abilities, and 61 ability haste brought them back 38% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 3 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Ortus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Noxia, Mutilator. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Phase). Anti-heal on Drongo, Eden. Health items on Gideon raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Wraith 7 times.
Copy it? Demiurge: 47.2% in 339 Wraith midlane games, level with the hero's 46.9%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
